title: CRLR/68/2003 of VIJAI MAMGAI and ANR. Vs STATE

paras.text:
Criminal Revision no.68 of 2003
Vijai Mamgai and another --------------- Revisionists
Versus
State of Uttaranchal
-------------- Respondent
Hon'ble M.M.Ghildiyal J.
 This is a revision against the order dated 05.02.2003 passed by
Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track Court, Pauri in sessions trial no.1 of
2000 allowing the application no. 19 Kha moved by the prosecution and
rejecting objection 33 Kha filed by the accused-revisionist and framing
additional charge under sections 366/511 I.P.C. by invoking jurisdiction
under section 216 Cr.P.C.
 The facts of the case are that the complainant lodged a FIR against the
revisionists on 28.2.2000 under sections 366/511/506 I.P.C. The matter was
investigated and statements of the complainant and the witnesses were
recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C. After completing the investigation the
Investigating Officer submitted chargesheet under section 3 (i)(x) of the
Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes Prevention of Atrocities Act and
under sections 504/506 IPC. During the trial the statement of the
complainant was recorded and on the basis of the said statement
application 19 Kha for framing of additional charge under sections 366 and
511 IPC, was allowed. Aggrieved against this order framing of additional
charge revision has been filed.
 The learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that no case is
made out under sections 366/511 IPC and as such the chargesheet may be
quashed. It is well settled law that the learned trial court has jurisdiction to
add or alter change in case a case is made out prima facie on the basis of
evidence during trial. The charge can be altered or added at any stage before
the judgment is pronounced. I find no illegality in the order passed b by the

Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track Court, Pauri. However, in the
circumstances of the case, it would be proper to direct the learned trial court
to conclude the trial expeditiously as early as possible.
 With these observations the revision is finally disposed of.
 (M.M.Ghildiyal, J.)
May 19, 2003
MPS
